incidents.title: Node.js Heap Memory Leak — Global Cache Accumulation
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded global array (globalEventCache) accumulation in Node.js recommendation-engine service
incidents.fix: Implement an eviction policy for the globalEventCache array, such as a LRU (Least Recently Used) cache or a size-based limit, to prevent unbounded growth and mitigate the memory leak.

incidents.title: API Errors
incidents.fix: Monitor the service for an extended period to ensure the fix is effective and make adjustments as necessary.
